what: 10-in-1 retro arcade multicart for the M-VAVE FM-1: Snake, Tetris (Korobeiniki BGM), Arkanoid (KNOB1 paddle), OutRun (4-voice FM + drums MIDI OST), Synth Hero (7/12-key rhythm), Frogger, Galaga, Pac-Man, Chrome Dino Run, and Flappy Bird, with per-game LEDs and saved high scores.
author: Gas (gaskb)
